title: ks.world: catalogue tool adapters with read/write sets
outcome: Every ADR-06 catalogue tool executes over ks.state inside the gateway txn and returns its read_set/write_set and class
acceptance: All catalogue tools (R, C, I1, I2) implemented; test_catalogue_covers_world: every tool an agent can emit has an adapter and a class
Each adapter's read_set/write_set equals the objects it touched (property test over 200 random calls)
I1 tools (payments.send, comms.send_email) never execute inline; they return an outbox enqueue request
